Main application for nim_express Optimized with route grouping and sync/async handler support Supports multi-threaded and multi-process modes for high throughputGenerate a fallback correlation id from a tick counter and epoch micros.Emit an InspectorEvent to the app's inspector hook if one is installed.Install the inspector hook that receives InspectorEvent notifications.Build a PluginDefinition from an id, dependencies, config, and hooks.Register a plugin before listen starts. Returns false on invalid or duplicate ids.Initialize registered plugins in dependency order. Returns false on failure.Run plugin shutdown hooks in reverse initialization order.Add an advice hook that runs before route matching and can short-circuit.Add an advice hook that runs after route match and before the handler.Add an advice hook that runs after the route handler completes.Add an advice hook that observes handler and middleware errors.Count an async pump poll failure and report a throttled summary to the error hook.Total async pump poll failures recorded so far.Reset async pump poll failure counters.
